description: Offline-first notes client: local store of record, background sync, and a small REST boundary.
architecturalConstraints: The local database is the store of record; the API is a replication peer, never a read path for the UI.
Features read and write through the notes store; no feature constructs its own API client.
Every write lands locally before it is queued for sync, so the editor never waits on the network.

flowDiscovery: Search by flow label, operation, or source path
Filter user journeys separately from system flows

manualQA.contract: Each user flow defines checks with explicit expected results.
manualQA.persistence: Checkbox and status state is stored in the browser opening the dashboard.

nodes.label: User
nodes.description: Keyboard and pointer input that enters the app.
responsibilities: Open, read, edit, and search notes

nodes.label: App shell
nodes.description: Boots providers, hydrates the store from the local database, and mounts the router.

nodes.label: Router
nodes.description: Maps the URL to the list, editor, or search surface.
responsibilities: Own shareable view state in the URL

nodes.label: Note list
nodes.description: Renders the note index and selects the active note.

nodes.label: Note editor
nodes.description: Edits note body and title, committing debounced drafts to the store.

nodes.label: Search panel
nodes.description: Full-text query over the loaded notes with highlighted results.

nodes.label: Notes store
nodes.description: Client-authoritative note state that every feature reads and writes.

nodes.label: Notes service
nodes.description: Persists note writes locally and enqueues them for replication.

nodes.label: Sync worker
nodes.description: Drains the change queue on an interval and applies remote changes back.

nodes.label: API client
nodes.description: Authenticated transport for the sync endpoints.

nodes.label: Local database
nodes.description: Store of record for notes and the pending change queue.

nodes.label: Notes API
nodes.description: Replication peer holding the shared copy of every note.

edges.description: User picks a note from the index.
Note and queue rows are stored.
Each write becomes a queue entry.
Shell loads persisted notes at boot.

flows.label: Edit a note
flows.summary: Type into a note, commit the debounced draft to the store, and persist it locally without waiting on the network.
flows.trigger: Type in the editor on the note route.
flows.successOutcome: The note body updates instantly, the list title follows, and the change survives a reload.
flows.failureBehavior: A failed local write raises a save-failed banner and the draft stays in the editor for retry.

manual.label: Type continuously for ten seconds with the network offline.
manual.expected: No input lag or dropped characters, and no error appears.

manual.label: Edit a note, wait one second, then reload the page.
manual.expected: The edited text is present after hydration.

flows.label: Search notes
flows.summary: Filter loaded notes by query and open a result without leaving the search surface.
flows.trigger: Enter a query in the search panel.
flows.successOutcome: Matching notes list with highlighted terms within one frame of typing.
flows.failureBehavior: An empty result set renders the no-matches state rather than a blank panel.

manual.label: Search for a term that appears in a note body.
manual.expected: The note is listed and the term is highlighted in the preview.

manual.label: Search for a term no note contains.
manual.expected: The no-matches state renders and the previous results are cleared.

flows.label: Open a note from the list
flows.summary: Select a note in the index and render it in the editor from state already loaded.
flows.trigger: Click a row in the note list.
flows.successOutcome: The editor shows the selected note with no loading state, because the note is already in the store.
flows.failureBehavior: A missing note id routes back to the list rather than rendering an empty editor.

manual.label: Select several notes in quick succession.
manual.expected: Each opens immediately with no spinner between selections.

flows.label: Cold start and hydrate
flows.summary: Read persisted notes from the local database, populate the store, and mount the routed list before the first sync runs.
flows.successOutcome: The list renders real notes on first paint, offline included.
flows.failureBehavior: A corrupt local database is cleared and the app boots empty rather than failing to mount.

flows.label: Background sync
flows.summary: Drain the pending change queue to the API, pull changes since the last cursor, and merge them into the store.
flows.trigger: Sync interval elapses or the app regains connectivity.
flows.successOutcome: Local edits reach the server and remote edits appear without a reload.
flows.failureBehavior: A failed batch stays queued, retries with backoff, and never drops a local change.

manual.label: Edit three notes offline, then reconnect.
manual.expected: All three reach the server and the queue drains to empty.
